items.stem: Which TWO FFmpeg approaches keep captions as a selectable track rather than permanently drawn onto the picture? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Mux an SRT/mov_text subtitle stream into the container
options.rationale: Correct: a soft subtitle stream stays selectable and can be toggled.

options.text: Add a WebVTT subtitle track alongside the video
options.rationale: Correct: a sidecar/soft WebVTT track remains selectable.

options.text: Use the subtitles filter to burn them into the frames
options.rationale: Burning in draws captions onto the picture permanently.

options.text: Overlay text with the drawtext filter
options.rationale: drawtext renders text into the video frames.

items.explanation: Correct: a soft subtitle stream stays selectable and can be toggled.
